subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**Noble**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes nursing as a profession that goes beyond mere duty and involves grace and service.
 
• The word "calling" suggests a deep sense of purpose and dedication.
 
• "**Noble**" fits well as it denotes a profession that is honorable, selfless, and dedicated to helping others.
 
• Other options ("**Diffident**", "**Problematic**", "**Corrosive**") do not fit the context of describing a calling that is associated with service and privilege.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
